question_text: A wife complains that her husband controls all the family finances, gives her only a small allowance, and prevents her from working. She feels trapped and financially dependent. Under RA 9262 (Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act), which of the following best describes this situation?

options.text: This is not a form of violence because there is no physical harm.
This constitutes economic abuse, which is a form of violence under RA 9262.
This is a civil matter that should be resolved through family court mediation.
This is psychological abuse only, not economic abuse.
